en.headline: LCSD venues free and cinema tickets half-price on National Day
en.dek: Residents can book selected Leisure and Cultural Services Department sports facilities at no charge today, while 52 commercial cinemas sell half-price tickets and trams run free.
body: The government said selected charged leisure facilities under the Leisure and Cultural Services Department are free for personal use on Thursday for National Day. That covers badminton, tennis, basketball and squash courts, table tennis tables, lawn bowls greens, fitness rooms, golf facilities, public swimming pools and craft at water sports centres, subject to booking rules and opening hours.

All 52 commercial cinemas in the city are offering half-price tickets for screenings today under a government-backed promotion. Hong Kong Wetland Park is also free. Hong Kong Tramways is carrying passengers without charge on all passenger routes, and Star Ferry and Fortune Ferry are waiving fares on specified harbour crossings.

MTR is drawing 77,000 electronic single-journey tickets through the MTR Mobile app for local, Lo Wu or Lok Ma Chau, and Airport Express trips, excluding High Speed Rail, Light Rail, East Rail first class and MTR buses. Children using Octopus can ride most daytime franchised bus routes of KMB, Long Win, Citybus and New Lantao Bus free, with listed overnight exceptions. Demand for cinema seats and sports bookings has been heavy since tickets opened on 28 September.

zh.headline: 國慶康文署設施免費 戲票半價電車免車費
zh.dek: 今日以個人身分可免費預訂康文署部分收費康樂設施，全港52間商業戲院半價，電車全線免車費，濕地公園亦免費開放。
body: 政府公布，國慶日市民可以個人身分免費使用康樂及文化事務署轄下部分收費康樂設施，包括羽毛球場、網球場、籃球場、壁球場、乒乓球枱、草地滾球場、健身室、高爾夫球設施、公眾游泳池及水上活動中心艇隻，仍須按各場地開放時間及預訂規則辦理。
全港52間商業戲院今日提供半價戲票。香港濕地公園免費入場。電車全線載客服務免車費，天星小輪及富裕小輪指定航線亦免船費。
港鐵經MTR Mobile抽獎送出77,000份電子單程車程，適用於本地車程、羅湖或落馬洲過境車程及機場快綫，不包括高速鐵路、輕鐵、東鐵綫頭等及港鐵巴士。小童以八達通可免費乘搭九巴、龍運、城巴及新大嶼山巴士大部分日間專營路線，個別通宵線除外。戲票及場地預訂自九月二十八日開放以來需求殷切。
